remarks: Set on a full acre in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods, this property presents a rare and versatile opportunity for visionary buyers. Whether you choose to undertake a renovation-reviving the charm of mid-century modern design-or build a custom new construction estate from the ground up, the potential here is extraordinary. Surrounded by multi-million dollar homes, this centrally located parcel offers an ideal blend of privacy and convenience. Just moments from the highly regarded Middlesex Middle School and Darien High School, as well as the Noroton Heights train station, shopping, and dining, the location is as practical as it is prestigious. In addition to the main residence, the property features an existing accessory dwelling-perfect for a guest house, home office, or au pair suite-complete with a spacious great room, kitchenette, bedroom, and full bath. Recent comparables in the area attracted multiple offers, underscoring the exceptional value and demand for properties like this. Whether you're an end-user with vision or a developer seeking a standout project, this is an investment that delivers on both lifestyle and long-term value. Don't miss this chance to create something truly special in one of Darien's premier enclaves. Property is being sold as is.
